title: An Augmented Lagrangian Approach to Lifted Bellman Linear Programming
abstract: arXiv:2611.14183v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Temporal-difference critics regress onto a bootstrapped target and usually need a target network. Lifted Bellman Linear Programming (LBLP) instead expresses the in-sample optimal values of offline RL as the solution to a linear program over the dataset. Its neural solver ALBUM relaxes the constraints into hinge penalties with fixed coefficients, and its guarantees are conditions on coefficients chosen in advance. We solve the same program with the method of multipliers: the coefficients become multipliers learned by dual ascent, with one penalty parameter $\rho$. In the convex case the fixed points are the KKT pairs of LBLP, and at every stationary point the applied constraint weights balance the objective exactly. The critic can serve a Gaussian actor, a flow actor, and best-of-N sampling, and for the Gaussian actor we propose an advantage-normalized DDPG+BC objective. translated_title: 一种求解提升贝尔曼线性规划的增广拉格朗日方法
translated_abstract: 时序差分（TD）评论家网络向自举目标回归，通常需要目标网络。提升贝尔曼线性规划（LBLP）则将离线强化学习的样本内最优值表示为数据集上一个线性规划的解。其神经求解器ALBUM将约束松弛为具有固定系数的合页惩罚，其理论保证是对预先选定系数的条件。我们采用乘子法求解同一规划：系数变为通过对偶上升学习的乘子，仅引入一个惩罚参数ρ。在凸情形下，算法的不动点即为LBLP的KKT点对，且在每个平稳点处，所施加的约束权重恰好精确平衡目标函数。该评论家网络可服务于高斯演员、流演员以及best-of-N采样，针对高斯演员我们提出了优势归一化的DDPG+BC目标。使用单个Q和V且无需目标网络，我们的AL-LBLP……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出用增广拉格朗日乘子法求解提升贝尔曼线性规划（LBLP），将固定的惩罚系数变为通过对偶上升学习的乘子，在无需目标网络的情况下为离线强化学习提供了具有KKT理论保证的神经求解器AL-LBLP。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes solving Lifted Bellman Linear Programming (LBLP) via an augmented Lagrangian method of multipliers, where fixed penalty coefficients become multipliers learned by dual ascent, yielding a neural solver AL-LBLP with KKT guarantees for offline RL without requiring a target network.
